title: nbn Incident INC000022473788 -
current_summary: We are aware of an issue on the access network affecting one broadband service. The affected connection may be offline or experience intermittent connectivity. Our team is working with our network partner to restore service as quickly as possible. There is no estimated restoration time yet.

updates.content: We are investigating an issue on the access network affecting one broadband service. Customers on the affected connection may be offline or see intermittent connectivity. Our team is working with our network partner to restore service as quickly as possible. There is no estimated restoration time yet. We will share updates as soon as more information becomes available. Thank you for your patience.
